column1: # Format: file <TAB> code <TAB> why absence means zero HERE.
# Keyed on the code, not the line number, so an edit above a row does not
# invalidate it. A justification has to name the semantics that make zero the
# right reading -- "it is fine" is not one.
# A NEW hit fails the build. See the header of the script for what to do.

column3: Left-join miss: the unit is absent from within_day_var, which means it was counted once, so its within-day term is 0 and k_d is 1 (VAR-03). Only safe because read_supplied_within_day_var() refuses NA at entry, so the table cannot hold an unknown (#317).
Statistical claim, not a fallback: with no expansion component there is no shared multiplier error, so the covariance between groups genuinely is zero.
Second arm of the same claim, for the branch where the expansion carries no standard error.

Reached only under is.null(var_expansion_named): the design carries no expansion at all, so every group's contribution is zero rather than unknown. The NA-vs-absent case is handled in the else branch, which tests the key.
Left-join miss on the catch table: add_catch() documents that an angler who caught none of a species need not appear at all, so an absent row means zero caught. summarize_cws_rates().
Same reading, summarize_hws_rates(). The two functions are near-twins; a change to one belongs in the other.

Accumulator seed, not an absence conversion: the components are added on the following lines, and an NA in any of them propagates through `+` rather than being zeroed. A design with no components at all is refused earlier.

An interview absent from the catch table for this species caught none of it -- documented by add_catch(), and deliberately kept apart from a missing caught row alongside recorded dispositions, which means derive (#318).
CATCH-04 validation. A pair with no harvested/released rows recorded a sub-total of zero; the full-partition flag is taken BEFORE this fill precisely so the two cases stay apart.
Bin counts from the wide reshape: an interview with no measured fish in this age bin measured zero in it. Absence in the reshape is the absence of a measurement, not an unknown count.
Same reading for length bins. The two files are near-twins; a change to one belongs in the other.

A group svyby reported but the counts table does not contain has no sampled units, which is a count of zero rather than an unknown one (#317). The estimate itself is matched on the key, not this fill.
Left-join miss on the catch table: add_catch() documents that an angler who released none of a species need not appear, so an absent row means zero released.
Same reading for the species catch join; deliberately distinct from a missing `caught` row alongside recorded dispositions, which means derive (#318).

A group with no successful parties counted zero of them. NOTE: the UPSTREAM count in summarize_successful_parties() decides success from catch_type == 'caught' with no fallback, which is a known open defect (#317, ninth instance) -- this fill is not the bug and fixing it here would hide it.

match() miss over the UNION of both allocations' strata: a stratum present only in the final allocation had zero baseline days by construction. The diagnostic immediately below exists to report exactly that case.
Mirror of the row above, for a stratum present only in the baseline -- which is the 'fully consumed by special-period assignments' error the loop reports.
